```{r Setting Up Environment}
getwd()
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Only Big Island Sites}
CoverClass_Data <- 
  read.csv("Data/Raw/PACN_EIPS_Cover_Class_Data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

CoverClass_BigIsland <- 
  CoverClass_Data %>%
  filter(custom_samplingFrame %in% c("Mauna Loa", "Olaa", "Nahuku / East Rift"))

unique(CoverClass_BigIsland$custom_samplingFrame)
```

```{r Single Date Column}
BigIsland_Clean <- 
  CoverClass_BigIsland %>%
  select(-custom_startDate, -custom_eventTimeStart, -custom_eventTimeEnd) %>%
  rename(Date = custom_endDate)
```

```{r Processed with only 10 chosen variables and remove NA}
BigIsland_Processed <- BigIsland_Clean %>%
  select(custom_plantCommunity, custom_samplingFrame, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, geodeticDatum, Date, custom_speciesCode, scientificName, vernacularName, custom_lifeForm) %>%
  drop_na()

colnames(BigIsland_Processed) <- c("Plant_Community", "Sampling_Frame", "Decimal_Latitude", "Decimal_Longitude", "GeodeticDatum", "Date", "Species_Code", "Scientific_Name", "Vernacular_Name", "Life_Form")

BigIsland_Processed$Date <- ymd(BigIsland_Processed$Date)
class(BigIsland_Processed$Date)

write.csv(BigIsland_Processed, "Data/Processed/BigIsland_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r Mapping Exploration}
library(sf)

hawaii.counties <- st_read("Data/Raw/cb_2018_us_county_20m.shp")%>%
filter(STATEFP == 15 )

plot(hawaii.counties)

Hawaii.sf <-
st_as_sf(BigIsland_Clean,
coords = c("decimalLongitude","decimalLatitude"),
crs=26961)

plot(Hawaii.sf)

plots.and.counties <-
ggplot() +
geom_sf(data = hawaii.counties,color = "forestgreen", fill = "palegreen3") +
geom_sf(data = Hawaii.sf, color = "navy", fill = "navy")+
labs(title = "Plots in Hawaii")
plots.and.counties
```
